messages:
maya: Quick sync — launching a small tutorial series + OSS refapp next month. Need: launch post copy, benchmark narrative (concise), webinar hook, and inbound lead routing. Who can own what?
omar: Happy to lead demo + tutorial content. Thinking 3 short vids: setup, perf tuning, deploy to Redwood Private. Each 8–12 min.
claire: I can draft the launch post and social. For benchmark narrative I need 3 clear headlines (latency, cost per 1k tokens, improvement with batching). Do we have vetted numbers I can quote?
noah: We do. From the internal perf run: median token latency ~120ms on our standard gp-1024 test; batching + KV cache reduced per-token cost ~40% vs baseline. Will pull a one-paragraph blurb.
devrel-bot: benchmark-report uploaded: https://drive.redwood/refapp/benchmarks/ignite-2026.pdf
omar: For the webinar I propose 30 min: 10 min quick refapp walkthrough, 10 min live bench run showing before/after cost, 10 min Q&A. Speakers: Omar (demo) + Maya (narrative) + Noah (bench).
claire: I'll own registration and the nurture flow. Routing plan: add utm_campaign=ignite-refapp, lead_source=webinar, and auto-tag leads in HubSpot with "refapp_interest" property. Landing page -> /refapp/ignite/get-started. Sales one-pager needed.
noah: Slide idea: "How we cut unit cost" with a tiny table and this example snippet:
```
Before: batch_size=1 -> cost_per_1k = $0.20, median latency 180ms
After: batch_size=8 + quant -> cost_per_1k = $0.12, median latency 120ms
```
Keep wording cautious (subject to legal).
maya: Timeline: draft copy by Friday (3 days), benchmark PR by Tue, webinar dry-run next Wed. Omar can you open the test harness PR for the live bench?
omar: Yep — opening PR now and will ping ops for infra slot. PR: https://git.redwood/refapp/bench-harness/pull/42
claire: :thumbsup: I'll set up registration, calendar, and a 3-email nurture (reminder, day-of, replay + CTA). Also will create the social playbook.
maya: Legal review on benchmark claims — should we cc Sasha from legal? Noah please tag her in the benchmark PR.
noah: Will do. Tagging plan: @sasha-legal for claim review.
maya: Great — I'll create a marketing-drive folder and drop the assets. Quick ask: keep all social snippets <200 chars and have one hero benchmark stat for the post.
omar: Agreed. Anything else?
claire: I'll mock the hero stat and A/B test two headlines in the registration flow.
maya: Thanks all — I'll follow up with required copy checklist in the folder.
